title: Trapfeaster
summary: Trapfeaster deals with pesky traps and inconveniences in his own special way by eating them, unlike many trap-detecting Titans who simply alert their Seekers to the danger. He's as happy swallowing an arrow meant for his Seeker as he is sucking the magic out of a cursed doorknob.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Trapfeaster was used by [[the Professor]] in [[King Solomon's mines]] alongside [[Goblin Brownie]] to help deactivate the traps that were being aimed at the Professor. This Titan managed to eat the arrows that were released before triggering another trap, which Goblin Brownie quickly defused. {{Source|To Be Together}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Trapfeaster can eat projectiles that are released from traps, shielding its Seeker from these ranged attacks. {{source|To Be Together}} He is also capable of directly consuming curses and other enchantments by simply sucking them up. {{source|Huntik.com}}

full_text:
Trapfeaster deals with pesky traps and inconveniences in his own special way by eating them, unlike many trap-detecting Titans who simply alert their Seekers to the danger. He's as happy swallowing an arrow meant for his Seeker as he is sucking the magic out of a cursed doorknob.

== History ==
Trapfeaster was used by the Professor in King Solomon's mines alongside Goblin Brownie to help deactivate the traps that were being aimed at the Professor. This Titan managed to eat the arrows that were released before triggering another trap, which Goblin Brownie quickly defused. [To Be Together]

== Abilities ==
Trapfeaster can eat projectiles that are released from traps, shielding its Seeker from these ranged attacks. [To Be Together] He is also capable of directly consuming curses and other enchantments by simply sucking them up. [Huntik.com]
